class_policy: Preserve each active category name and ID relation. Similar names were not merged without domain evidence.
scope: Object detection from still images; dataset labels do not establish field-level agronomic diagnosis or drone suitability.

validation.duplicate_annotation_policy: Preserved and reported; labels were not silently removed.
validation.segmentation_policy: COCO bbox is used for detection; segmentation polygons are not used as training masks.

leakage_control.policy: Linked components of byte SHA256, decoded RGB pixel SHA256, and original .rf. basename; retain test > valid > train. Lower-priority members are excluded, never reassigned.
leakage_control.rf_heuristic: Only names matching PREFIX.rf.HEX.EXT are grouped. PREFIX is case-folded. This is conservative source-family evidence, not proof of identical scenes; filename collisions can over-group unrelated images.
leakage_control.exact_duplicate_policy: Within the retained split, only identical RGB pixels AND identical box/class labels are deduplicated. Augmented family members and label conflicts are kept and reported.
leakage_control.residual_risk: Perceptually similar images, alternate filenames, recompressed/resized copies without shared .rf. prefixes, adjacent video frames, and common farms/capture sessions are not proven independent. No perceptual or spatial/temporal near-duplicate detection is claimed. Verify source-group and field independence before operational accuracy claims.
